import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Calculate the average spending per product category for each education level
education_spending = df.pivot_table(
    index='Education',
    values=['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds'],
    aggfunc='mean'
)

# Then, create a heatmap
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.heatmap(education_spending, annot=True, fmt='.0f', cmap='YlGnBu')
plt.title('Average Spending by Education Level and Product Category')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
